messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a three‑day weekend; if the holiday falls on a weekend, the following Monday is typically observed):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) | Observed on Monday |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | — |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | — |
| Easter Monday (observed in some provinces) | Apr 10 (Monday) | — | — |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | — | — |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) | Observed on Monday |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | — |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | — |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Monday) | — | — |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | — |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | — |

**Long‑weekend combinations**

| Weekend | Dates | Holiday(s) |
|---------|-------|------------|
| New Year’s | Dec 30 2022 – Jan 2 2023 | New Year’s Day (observed) |
| Family Day | Feb 18–20 | Family Day |
| Good Friday | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| Easter Monday | Apr 10–12 | Easter Monday |
| Victoria Day | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| Canada Day | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day (observed) |
| Labour Day | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 9–11 | Remembrance Day |
| Christmas & Boxing | Dec 23–26 | Christmas & Boxing Day |

These are the standard public‑holiday long weekends that most Canadians observe in 2023. If you need province‑specific variations (e.g., Family Day dates differ in some provinces), let me know!
